newsitem.title: UK: Greenalls plans to invest 170 million stg.
newsitem.headline: Greenalls plans to invest 170 million stg.

text.p: British pub-to-hotel group Greenalls Plc said on Thursday it planned to spend 170 million stg on developing the business in 1996/97, including about 80 million on acquisitions and new building.
About 40 million stg will go on extending its Greenalls pub concepts and about the same amount on its pub restaurants and lodges.
The group said it would also spend 19 million stg on its De Vere hotels in 1996/97, developing De Vere golf and resort hotels and others like the Cameron House hotel in Scotland.
The company said it would spend some 20 million stg on expanding its Village Leisure hotels and 8 million will go on developing more Greenalls Cellars.
The group's total capital expenditure will be slightly down on 1995/96 when it was able to put 20 million stg in from the sale of its nursing home business for 68 million stg.
